row.proto: void *Career_CostCap_CollectScaledLedgerEntries(void *comp, void *outVec, uint32_t team, uint32_t from, uint32_t to)
row.notes: Calls Career_Bank_CollectLedgerEntriesInRange(comp+0x290) and Career_CostCap_FindTeamInfo, then copies into outVec (0x14-byte elements, allocator comp+0x210) every ledger entry whose kind byte +0x11 is 1 with type in {11,12,28} or kind 0 with type 6, multiplying the int amount at +4 by the team info float factor. Returns outVec. Hook here to change what counts toward the cost cap.
